question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between the following classes.

Sportspersons, Shooters, Swimmers
solution:
Given: Sportspersons, Shooters, Swimmers

Logic: All shooters and swimmers are sportspersons but shooters and swimmers have no common relation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85e7b88ec343eef14bb74b03a3a491e79fc046e5ff328bd755ddab1d5d2ef69a.png] 

Hence, **option (2) **is the correct answer.
